note: First edition of the delivery plan. The grid connection (Essential Energy's Chapter 5A process, 2-3 years end to end) and an 8-14 month transformer lead time set the pace, so the site can't be energised before about August 2029, later than the 2027 start the cash-flow model assumes. The property sold on 7 April 2026 for A$1.15M and isn't listed, so the first step is an option with the new owner.

steps.title: Secure the site with a conditional option to buy
steps.detail: The property changed hands on 7 April 2026 and isn't listed. Offer the owner an option to buy at about {landPrice}, conditional on development consent and a grid connection offer, with access for surveys in the meantime; a long lease with an option to buy is the fallback.
steps.who: Owner of 18 Clovernook Drive, with a conveyancer

sources.title: OnTheHouse: 18 Clovernook Drive sold on 7 Apr 2026 for A$1,150,000 (listed Jan 2025 at A$1,250,000)
Homely: 'Clover Downs' sale listing, 32 acres

steps.title: Approve the development budget ({capex.dev})
steps.detail: Studies, design and Council and Essential Energy fees are spent before the investment decision and are lost if the project stops, so approve {capex.dev} for this stage.

sources.title: Clovernook Farm: capital cost by item (Finance tab)
Essential Energy: connection application costs in CEOP8079 Annexure A

steps.title: Survey, flood levels and soil tests
steps.detail: Detail and level survey; ask Council for the design flood levels (the plan builds to a {fpl} m AHD flood planning level); test the soils for piles and acid sulfate soils.
steps.who: Registered surveyor, geotechnical engineer and MidCoast Council

sources.title: Manning River Floodplain Risk Management Study and Plan (MidCoast Council)
MidCoast Council: flood risk management plans to be updated

steps.title: Concept design and capital investment value
steps.detail: Turn the plan into concept drawings: {summary}. The capital investment value decides who determines the DA.

sources.title: Clovernook Farm: layout on the real lot (Site & layout tab)

steps.title: Pre-lodgement meeting with MidCoast Council
steps.detail: Request a pre-lodgement meeting (A$625 including GST). Meetings run on Tuesdays at 9, 10 or 11 am and formal minutes follow within 21 days. Bring a statement comparing the proposal with the LEP and DCP, a site plan, concept plans and the capital investment value.

sources.title: MidCoast Council: pre-lodgement meetings

steps.title: Specialist studies
steps.detail: Flood impact and risk, acid sulfate soils management, bush fire assessment to Planning for Bush Fire Protection 2019, glint and glare for Taree Airport, biodiversity and koalas, noise from cooling and inverters, traffic and visual impact.
steps.who: Flood, soils, bush fire, glare, ecology, acoustic, traffic and visual consultants

sources.title: Clovernook Farm: studies the DA will need (Approvals tab)
NSW RFS: Planning for Bush Fire Protection

steps.title: Lodge the development application
steps.detail: Lodge one DA for the whole site. Electricity generating works worth more than A$5M are regionally significant development, decided by the Hunter and Central Coast Regional Planning Panel rather than Council.
steps.who: NSW Planning Portal and MidCoast Council

variants.detail: Lodge one DA for the whole site. Electricity generating works worth more than A$5M are regionally significant development, decided by the Hunter and Central Coast Regional Planning Panel rather than Council. The cabins are tourist accommodation on bush fire prone land, so the DA is integrated development and needs a bush fire safety authority (a new RFS process applies from 1 July 2026).

sources.title: NSW Planning Portal: regionally significant development (private infrastructure over A$5M)
NSW RFS: issuing a bush fire safety authority for integrated development from 1 July 2026

steps.title: Assessment and development consent
steps.detail: Public exhibition, referrals, assessment and a public panel meeting. Allow six to nine months (planning estimate); the consent conditions set the flood, bush fire, glare and noise requirements.
steps.who: Regional planning panel or MidCoast Council

sources.title: NSW Planning Portal: regionally significant development and planning panels

steps.title: Register on the Essential Connections Portal
steps.detail: Register as a High Voltage customer for major connections; registrations are processed within five business days.

sources.title: Essential Energy: HV connections and large embedded generators

steps.title: Preliminary enquiry
steps.detail: Ask for {kwac} of solar inverters plus a {bessKw} battery, {importKw} of import and {exportKw} of export. Under 5 MW this is a Chapter 5A connection, exempt from AEMO registration; the response takes about a month.

variants.detail: Ask for {kwac} of solar inverters plus a {bessKw} battery, {importKw} of import and {exportKw} of export. At 5 MW or more this is a Chapter 5 connection that needs AEMO registration and takes 3-5 years end to end.

sources.title: Essential Energy: HV connection types and timeline (Chapter 5A under 5 MW, Chapter 5 above)

steps.title: Connection investigation response
steps.detail: Choose the preferred connection option; Essential Energy sets out the network augmentation and requirements (about 2 months).

sources.title: Essential Energy: HV connections timeline (stage 2, 2 months)

steps.title: Connection application and network studies
steps.detail: Apply with the inverter, battery and protection details, including the emergency backstop and SCADA requirements for HV embedded generation. Studies take 6-9 months under Chapter 5A.
steps.who: Essential Energy and the owner's power systems consultant

variants.detail: Apply with the inverter, battery and protection details, including the emergency backstop and SCADA requirements. Studies take 10-15 months under Chapter 5.

sources.title: Essential Energy: HV connections timeline (stage 3, 6-9 months for Chapter 5A)

steps.title: Connection offer and contract terms
steps.detail: Negotiate the offer: the technical schedule, the connection charge ({capex.grid} in this plan) and whether Essential Energy or an Accredited Service Provider builds the works (4-6 months).

variants.detail: Negotiate the offer: the technical schedule, the connection charge ({capex.grid} in this plan) and who builds the works (10-15 months under Chapter 5).

sources.title: Essential Energy: HV connections timeline (stage 4, contract development)

steps.title: GPU customers: letters of intent
steps.detail: Approach three to five buyers for 12-36 month reserved contracts covering at least {gpusHalf} of the {gpus} {gpuModel} GPUs at or above the plan's US${gpuPrice} per GPU-hour, starting at energisation.
steps.who: AI companies, neoclouds and GPU marketplaces

sources.title: Bargo: B200 on-demand, reserved and spot rents
Clovernook Farm: GPU rents used by the model (Markets tab)

steps.title: Firm server quotes
steps.detail: Quotes for {servers} × {gpuLabel} servers ({capex.servers} in this plan). Resellers quote HGX boards at 3-8 weeks' shipping, but complete servers take longer and Blackwell supply is allocated.

sources.title: Gatewell: HGX B300, B200 and H200 board prices and shipping times
Mercatus: 8-GPU server prices and allocation

steps.title: Sign the GPU offtake
steps.detail: Sign take-or-pay contracts for at least {gpusHalf} GPUs (about {gpuHoursHalf} GPU-hours a year) with a deposit, start dates tied to energisation and service levels the site can meet.

sources.title: Clovernook Farm: GPU utilisation and revenue (GPU compute tab)

steps.title: Arrange finance for {capexTotal}
steps.detail: Lenders want contracted income: the homestead lease, cabin bookings and an energy offtake; the land and farm assets secure the rest.

variants.who: Banks, private credit and GPU financiers
variants.detail: Lenders want contracted income: the GPU offtake first, then the homestead lease and an energy offtake. Specialist lenders finance GPU servers against signed offtake; the land and farm assets secure the rest.

sources.title: American Compute: GPU financing and residual values

steps.title: Tender the construction works
steps.detail: Fixed-price tenders, valid until the investment decision, for the {kwdc} {pvType} array, the {bessKw} / {bessKwh} battery, the flood-raised platform and the HV works.

sources.title: Small (1-5 MW) Australian solar farm build costs
Modo Energy: battery build costs in Australia (2026)

steps.title: Final investment decision
steps.detail: Go or no-go: consent granted, connection offer in hand, finance approved and fixed construction prices. Then commit the build budget.

variants.detail: Go or no-go: consent granted, connection offer in hand, at least {gpusHalf} GPUs contracted, finance approved and fixed construction prices. Exercise the land option ({capex.land} with duty) and commit the build budget.
Go or no-go: consent granted, connection offer in hand, finance approved and fixed construction prices. Exercise the land option ({capex.land} with duty) and commit the build budget.
Go or no-go: consent granted, connection offer in hand, at least {gpusHalf} GPUs contracted, finance approved and fixed construction prices. Then commit the build budget.

sources.title: Clovernook Farm: cash flow and returns (Finance tab)

steps.title: Accept the connection offer ({capex.grid})
steps.detail: Sign the connection contract and pay for the connection works. Accepting before the investment decision saves months but puts the money at risk.

sources.title: Essential Energy: HV connections and large embedded generators

steps.title: Sign the construction contract
steps.detail: Commit the solar array, battery, raised platform and the contingency budget.

sources.title: Clovernook Farm: capital cost by item (Finance tab)

steps.title: Order the HV kiosk, transformer and switchgear
steps.detail: Distribution transformers up to 5 MVA are quoted at 8-14 months (US market, 2026), so reserve a manufacturing slot as soon as the connection offer fixes the specification; a cancellable deposit keeps energisation on time.

sources.title: Nexus Power: transformer lead times in 2026 (distribution class up to 5 MVA: 8-14 months)

steps.title: Battery supply ({bessKw} / {bessKwh})
steps.detail: Containerised LFP: 12-26 weeks of factory build, 4-9 weeks of shipping and 4-6 weeks of heavy-haul permits, so 5-8 months from order to pad.
steps.who: Battery maker, through the EPC contractor

sources.title: SourceBySpec: BESS container lead times in 2026

sources.title: InfoLink: TOPCon module spot prices

steps.detail: A {itKw} (IT) modular data hall with cooling and power distribution, and a fibre service. Order the fibre early: regional fibre builds take months.
